units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="T00128"><he>רֹבַע</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 23:10">Num. XXIII, 10</cite>) <he>הר׳ שלהן … אוכלוסין שיצאו וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>הרביעית</he>, corr. acc.) who can count their fructifications, that is, the masses that came forth from those (women) who anxiously seized the opportunity of, and loved noble deeds &c.; <cite ref="Niddah 31a:26-69">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה … רְבִיעִיּוֹתֵיהֶם וכ׳</he> the Lord counts Israel’s fructifications, ‘when will the sperm come of which the righteous shall be created’?
